title: Resolve clamp qualification with one prospective 90-pair instrument
hypothesis: Removing reactive capture compression improves sustained spinning by preventing grasp-induced losses, and a prospectively enlarged paired measurement can resolve that gain.

prediction.rationale: Sustained success is the qualification endpoint; +0.05 is a conservative transferable gain. Unlike D-056, this is one predeclared 90-pair measurement, not another 30-pair retry or retrospective pooling.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r080_zero_curl_qualification_90 --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r080_zero_curl_qualification_90"'
code_changes: Study r080_zero_curl_qualification_90 (lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/clamp_qualification.py generalised to several panels) registered in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Parent config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent and the exact D-052 clamp (R-065's curl_clamp substitution), hashes checked; offline identity gate at factor 1.0 on D-050's archived observations before any episode.

Three frozen 40-case Stage-3 manifests on seeds 4660, 4661, 4662 (cases 0-9 unused, cases 10-39 the promotion panel of each), placement-disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest and from each other. Parent and clamp each run each panel in their own fresh process: six processes, 180 episodes, zero LLM calls.

One-off instrument of the existing strict rule, not a standing gate change: one paired t interval at the existing confidence level over the 90 prospectively declared paired differences; qualification requires a positive mean and a lower bound strictly above zero, and repair additionally requires no more observed drops over the 90 pairs. No extension, retry, selection or historical pooling; historical panels are excluded from the instrument.

Primary: clamp minus parent pooled over the 90 pairs; prediction at least +0.05, refuted if the upper bound is below +0.05, inconclusive if the interval spans zero. Reported: the pooled and each panel's own intervals, drops, failure split (drops, off-centre, slow spin), in-play mean |spin|, drive and per-axis executed-action saturation; a machine-readable qualification artifact (qualification.json) for the conditional R-081/R-082. Held-out split untouched.

falsified_by: The paired success interval's upper bound is below +0.05. An interval spanning zero is inconclusive and does not qualify the clamp; more observed drops also blocks its use for repair.

controls.parent: the unchanged frozen R-046 learner on every panel in its own process
controls.identity_gate: the curl_clamp substitution at factor 1.0 reproduced the parent's actions bit for bit on all 23,484 archived D-050 observations before any episode
controls.instrument: three independent 40-case manifests (seeds 4660-4662, reserved by this protocol, disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest and each other), cases 10-39 of each, one paired t interval over the 90 prospectively declared differences at the existing confidence level; no extension, retry, selection or historical pooling; historical panels excluded

notes: Primary, predeclared (90 pairs): clamp minus parent +0.1667 [+0.0401, +0.2932] (34/90 vs 19/90; 25 wins, 10 losses, 55 ties). The mean exceeds +0.05 and the lower bound is above zero: supported, and the qualification rule (positive mean, lower bound strictly above zero at the existing confidence level) is met. Drops 4 vs 10 (-0.0667 [-0.1279, -0.0055], an established reduction), so the clamp is eligible as the repair parent; off-centre tail failures 0 vs 22, slow-spin tail failures 52 vs 39, in-play |spin| 4.55 vs 4.75 rad/s.

Per panel (reported, not the instrument): s4660 +0.167 [-0.094, +0.428] (12 vs 7; drops 1 vs 6); s4661 +0.233 [+0.045, +0.422] (12 vs 5; drops 1 vs 1), the first single 30-case panel to clear the strict rule on its own; s4662 +0.100 [-0.127, +0.327] (10 vs 7; drops 2 vs 3). Every panel positive, as all four earlier panels were.

Standing of the frozen pair after this run: seven independent promotion panels (+0.200, 0.000, +0.233, +0.233, +0.167, +0.233, +0.100) and three fresh panels (+0.150, +0.069, +0.075), none negative; drops lower in every panel but one tie. The instrument answered what the 30-pair gate could not resolve, as predicted from its standard error.

Saturation: drive above 0.99 on 92-96% of recorded in-play steps in both arms; executed-action saturation 4.7% (clamp) vs 6.1% (parent). The clamp does not change the learner's saturated spin drive; it changes retention.

Accounting: 180 Isaac episodes in six fresh processes, 0 LLM calls, about 4 min wall time. No deviation from the approved protocol. Final-test split untouched. qualification.json is the machine-readable artifact the conditional R-081/R-082 read.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted at least +0.05 for the exact zero-curl clamp over the frozen parent on one prospectively declared 90-pair instrument (three independent cases-10-39 panels); observed +0.167 [+0.040, +0.293] (34 vs 19; 25 wins, 10 losses, 55 ties): mean above +0.05, lower bound above zero, supported, and the standing qualification rule is met under its own criterion at its own confidence level, with drops 4 vs 10 (-0.067 [-0.128, -0.005], established), so the clamp is eligible as the repair parent. Each panel was positive (+0.167, +0.233, +0.100) and one cleared the rule alone. With seven promotion panels and three fresh panels now all in the same direction, the effect is replicated as well as anything in this ledger; its size is about +0.15 to +0.20 on success and a two-thirds reduction in drops, and it leaves the slow-spin failure mode (52 of 90) as the thing to repair. Confidence 0.9: exact identity gate, prospective instrument, 90 pairs, the only caveat being one learner.
verdicts.next_experiment: Use the zero-curl clamp as the repair parent, frozen with its source and hash (logs/pen_spin/r080_zero_curl_qualification_90/zero_curl_source.py; the same substitution of config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent). Re-triage the stroke-side repairs against it in order: R-081 (direct spin-feedback authority over the stroke, with the constant-gain control), then R-082 or the deferred R-064/R-070/R-076; the target is the slow-spin tail (52 of 90), and the remaining drops are few (4 of 90).
